problem_type: Media-adjacent metadata has no contrast-preserving surface
symptom: Shot numbers and mounted-card badges are unreadable against media in light and dark themes.
direct_cause: Both badge renderers use muted ink on a transparent background, including the mounted-card overflow badge.
class_root: Shared shot metadata renderers do not own a foreground/background pair that preserves contrast independently of the underlying media.
internal_only_reason: This repair concerns existing internal token-backed badge renderers and their computed browser contrast; no new external API or dependency behavior.
invariants: All shot metadata badge text retains a conservative contrast floor of 4.5:1 over arbitrary media backgrounds in both themes.
generality_proof: The two shared badge renderers are used by every image/video shot host; both named-card and overflow branches receive the same token-backed surface. The browser test renders real TSX and compiles real Tailwind config, and the common measurement accounts for background and text alpha without assuming a page color.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own a readable theme-token foreground and overlay surface for all shot numbers.
Own a readable foreground and overlay surface for every named and overflow mount badge.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The transparent shot-number span is replaced by the token-backed overlay surface.
Both character and scene names share the fixed named-card rendering branch.
The overflow count receives the same surface and is independently measured.

recurrence.reason: Any media pixel or overlapping canvas node can match transparent badge text, for every future generation and either theme.
same_class_scan: Inspected ConvertShotToVideoButton.tsx shot number and ShotMountBadges.tsx named/overflow branches.
Inspected BaseGenerationNode.tsx metadata composition and NodeLabelRow.tsx framework placement.
Compared GenerationStatusBar.tsx existing paper/90 overlay with src/theme/nomi-tokens.css light/dark pairs.
Reviewed ui-driver.mjs contrast probe: white-background assumption cannot verify arbitrary media.

prevention.invariant: Every named or overflow mount badge and shot number owns an ink/paper overlay pair that meets 4.5:1 independently of media.
prevention.failure_mode: The generic browser contrast measurement reports violations when foreground/background luminance intervals overlap or the contrast floor falls below 4.5.
prevention.strategy: Apply the surface in the existing two shared badge renderers, removing transparent muted-ink styling; assert all renderer branches against actual compiled tokens.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed the transparent muted-ink-only metadata rendering in both shared components; no parallel renderer remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing React, Tailwind and browser APIs suffice; the defect is missing internal surface ownership.

migration: No stored state or data changes; existing nodes immediately render the new surface.
residual_risks: Full Electron before/after screenshots and canvas layout acceptance are performed by the coordinating task.

invariant_owner_layer.note: Real TSX and production Tailwind tokens are rendered in Chromium, with transparent/alpha/OKLCH class controls.
